JO_A.note: Johnston's Organ zone A. Plan said 'JO-A'; the dataset subdivides.

JO_B.note: JO zone B -- the courtship-song-tuned afferents (~100-500 Hz).

JO_E.note: JO zone E (gravity/wind). Splits into ED* and EV* subtypes.

JO_other.note: Remaining JO zones (C/D/F/mz) plus unassigned fragments.

AMMC_interneuron.note: AMMC local/projection interneurons, numbered AMMC001-038 in v1.0.

WED_interneuron.note: Wedge interneurons and wedge projection neurons (WEDPN*).

B1_interneuron.note: The classic AMMC 'B1' interneuron of the song-response literature. No v1.0 type, alias or synonym carries this name -- the AMMC/WED populations above are numbered instead. Left UNCONFIRMED on purpose: do not silently map it onto AMMC001 or JO-B1_a.

aPN1.note: Resolves only via synonyms (Vaughan 2014). Real types are SAD051_*/CB*.

vPN1.note: Resolves only via synonyms (Zhou 2015) to AVLP76[123]m. VP1m+VP2_lvPN1 is an olfactory projection neuron and a pure name collision -- excluded explicitly.

pC1.note: pC1 courtship-drive cluster; v1.0 splits it into pC1_* and pC1x_*.

pC2.note: pC2 is NOT a v1.0 type string. It survives only in synonyms, where it maps onto AVLP*/LAL*/SIP*/VES*/PVLP* 'm' types (pC2l and pC2m).

pIP10.note: The song command descending neuron. Exactly one bilateral pair.

wing_steering_MN.note: Steering MNs named in PLAN.md. iii2 and iii4 do NOT exist in v1.0 (only iii1 and iii3); ps2 does exist and the plan omitted it.

wing_power_MN.note: Indirect power muscles. Note the literal commas/spaces in the names.

wing_motor_all.note: Authoritative wing-motor set: annotation subclass 'wm'. Preferred over any name pattern -- this is the dataset's own grouping.

leg_MN_T2.note: Mesothoracic leg MNs, for the v2 'leg mode' large-kit tier.

octopaminergic.note: Genre-embedding injection site. OA-VUMa*/OA-VPM3/4 are real types; 'OA-VPM1'/'OA-VPM2' are NOT -- they are synonyms of DNg34/DNg104.
